caption: The video captures a static view across a green lawn onto a quiet residential street. On the left stands a two-story house with a white garage door and a covered front entry reached by steps. A paved road runs horizontally through the middle, marked by a round manhole cover, while a large tree trunk and the rear of a parked dark SUV fill the right foreground. A neighboring house and white vans sit beyond, and the framing stays constant. A person is visible on the front steps and porch of the house, standing near the entry. This figure remains in essentially the same spot for the rest of the view, with no clear translation along the steps or toward the road. Minor shifts in posture read as stillness rather than movement. Two brief events punctuate the still scene: a person walking a brown dog on a leash is momentarily visible on the road just right of the manhole, and a dark sedan is momentarily visible on the road near the center, neither persisting across the surrounding view. The SUV, vans, house, and tree remain fixed.
